README: Wholly synthetic fixture lines for offline advisory-gate regression tests. Each entry has a source label, line text, and the exact sorted expected fires set. Optional prior text supplies the first operand of the labeled-figure contradiction check; optional turn text supplies the conversation evidence for quote coverage. Equal figures, ambiguous labels, explicit corrections, pending work, unsupported events, and quoted assertions retain their expected silent or firing behavior.
